title: [finding] dispatch-gates derives the symbol-anchor sweeps only from their corpus paths, so a change that removes an anchored symbol from a TARGET file passes every local gate and reds CI
body:
**Filed by:** `domain:engine#1` (seat post #6367), `session_017ErfyP2Rx7XWHJA27QjyUi`, from PR #21695's CI.

## What happened (measured)

PR #21695 changed `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` so that it imports `validateRecordInScope` instead of `validateRecord`. The dev ran the full `dispatch-gates --commands` union (68 derived commands, every one exit 0) plus the 53-family artifact-roster block, all at head `b73f58e396`. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` was then red at the same head (job 111379104429), on step "ADR symbol anchors resolve (no line numbers survive)":

```
[unresolved-symbol] docs/adr/0020-state-machine-converge-and-enforce.md:52  `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#validateRecord`
    `validateRecord` has no declaration site or string-literal token in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`
```

The seat reproduced it with `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` on the PR head.

## Why no local gate caught it

The seat ran `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` at `origin/main` `251a7dd4b4`:

| change set | `check-adr-symbol-anchors` derived? |
|:--|:--|
| no paths | no |
| `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` | no. Its artifact-roster listing (54 families) and the full non-`--commands` output never name any `*symbol-anchors*` gate |
| `docs/adr/0020-state-machine-converge-and-enforce.md` | yes: the sweep and its `--self-test` |

The three symbol-anchor corpora each have two sides. A change on either side can red the sweep:
- `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (`docs/adr/**`);
- `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` (`scripts/**` comment prose);
- `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` (`packages/spec/src/**` docblocks).

The corpus side is the files holding the anchors. The derivation keys on it. The target side is any file an anchor names (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#validateRecord`). The derivation does not model that side, so a rename or a removed import in any anchored target file is invisible to every local union.

## Reach

- Each dispatch that touches a heavily anchored file (`engine.ts`, `protocol.ts`, the `record-validator` / `rule-validator` pair) can pass its whole local union and then lose one CI cycle plus a patch round. Here that is #21695.
- Engineering cost only. Nothing ships wrong: CI's step is the backstop and it held.

## Direction (for triage, not prescribed)

Either option fits:
- derive the symbol-anchor sweeps when a change set touches a file that some corpus anchor names. The resolver in `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` already extracts every anchor's target path.
- or list the three sweeps among the always-run families that `--commands` prints.

Dedupe words: dispatch-gates symbol anchor target reverse dependency adr-symbol-anchors not derived.
